fields.statement: At 965d6d13 (attempt 2): go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-settings|describe-golden|daemon-pause)$' -count=1 passed. daemon-settings.txtar checks every key with its default and source default; daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 1 then settings shows 1 (git config); bad key/values fail and write nothing; with maxRuns 1 a daemon --once poll of two ready change sets starts exactly one run; --max-runs 5 wins and daemon status shows source flag, and the next poll without the flag reads config again. describe-golden passes against the regenerated golden. By hand on a scratch repo, daemon set with an unknown key, maxRuns zero, ship sometimes, minFree lots and paused maybe each exited 2 and left no rhiza.daemon/rhiza.autonomy keys in git config. Attempt 1's finding (daemon-lock flaky) is fixed: the fix installs the interrupt handler before daemon.TryLock; TestScripts/daemon-lock passed 20 of 20 runs with -count=1. make check exited 0.
